sampling_rng.generator: Dedicated torch.Generator; indices alone transferred to GPU
sampling_rng.reason: PyTorch2.1 CUDA multinomial replacement lacks a strict deterministic cumsum implementation; deterministic algorithms remain enabled; all neural-network fitting remains CUDA within CEDIA

initialization: Strict corrected phase6 joint-selected state, no layer reset

data.reuse: Exact taxonomy-corrected phase6 tensors and reference vectors

pathology.thresholds: Same per-class validation F1 rule: 19 thresholds 0.05..0.95; ties higher
pathology.sampling: Half mass Primary5-negative, half Primary5-positive weighted by sum of inverse positive label supports; training only
pathology.label_weights: Primary5 weight 2, other existing pathology outputs weight 1, normalized weighted mean

optimization.scheduler: Non-legacy: cosine LR from stated rate to 10% of rate across 40 epochs; refits use same full-epoch schedule
optimization.rhythm_weights: Equal mass per observed source/class cell; no manual SB/LBBB multiplication; unknown rhythms zero

selection.joint_metric: rhythm source mean F1 + 0.5 * Primary5 macro-F1

execution: CEDIA Slurm GPU only; deterministic selected-trial refit; do not load follow-up until checkpoint selection is saved
